chars.WIFE: BROTHER'S WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late twenties wearing a bright fuchsia velvet house djellaba and a mustard-yellow headscarf tied back, gold hoop earrings, fierce eyebrows
chars.BROTHER: BROTHER: a lanky Moroccan man around 30 with a thin moustache and short black hair, wearing a faded olive-green tracksuit with white side stripes
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan man in his mid-twenties with short curly hair and light stubble, wearing a burgundy hoodie and dark jeans
chars.DAD: DAD: an older Moroccan man with a short grey beard, wearing a white djellaba and a beige knitted cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Inside a simple rural Moroccan house kitchen with tiled walls and a gas stove. Seen from the kitchen doorway: the BROTHER'S WIFE, mid-act, raises a black frying pan high above her head with an angry face, ready to throw it; the BROTHER flinches back with both hands up in panic. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, comic exaggerated expressions. Subjects centred, calm background at the edges. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Same rural Moroccan kitchen. The frying pan flies through the air (motion lines) toward the BROTHER, who ducks down comically with wide eyes; the BROTHER'S WIFE in the background just threw it, arm still extended, furious. Faces visible, comic tone, no blood, no injury. Subjects centred. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Rural Moroccan living room with low banquette sofas and a patterned rug. The BROTHER'S WIFE stands waving a big kitchen cleaver in the air, shouting, eyes blazing; the BROTHER peeks out terrified from behind the sofa cushion. Exaggerated comic cartoon style, nobody hurt, faces visible. Subjects centred. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Rural Moroccan living room. The BROTHER sits on the floor cushion with his head bowed low and shoulders hunched, obedient and silent, while the BROTHER'S WIFE stands over him with hands on hips, pointing a finger and scolding him, looking down at him with contempt. Faces visible, comic awkward tone. Subjects centred. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. A family gathering in a rural Moroccan living room with tea glasses on a low round table. The BROTHER suddenly stands up and faces his wife with an angry face for the first time; the BROTHER'S WIFE glares back, shocked; in the background the DAD rises with both arms raised, shouting at everyone. Tense but comic, faces visible. Subjects centred. No text.
